name: BL∞ Canonical Logic Stack — Dynamic Public Projection

projection.name: BL-RP / Reality Proposition
projection.description: Reality is distinguished from every model, description and finite observed slice. Actuality authority and generative precedence are separate axes.

projection.name: BL-GTP / GiaTai Proposition
projection.description: GiaTai is an assumed, represented or derived reality-state whose actuality is not yet established. Existence of the GiaTai object does not imply actuality of its referent.

projection.name: BL∞ dynamic possibility field
projection.description: BL∞ has no permanent above/below relation to Reality or GiaTai. It expands representations, possibilities, reachability and consequences under mode-dependent precedence.

projection.name: THUC_DINH / Reality-Determined mode
projection.description: Reality -> BL∞ -> GiaTai -> test interface -> Reality. Reality leads the generative cycle locally.

projection.name: GIA_DINH / Hypothesis-Determined mode
projection.description: GiaTai -> BL∞ -> consequence/test interface -> Reality -> revised GiaTai. GiaTai leads the local generative frame without acquiring actuality authority.

projection.name: Epistemic standing / scholarly entry
projection.description: BLEE separates equal standing to submit inspectable objects from unequal evidential weight; Academic Democracy provides the public scholarly interface.

projection.name: BL-HRD GiaTai/hypothesis processing
projection.description: GiaTai or reality gaps become hypothesis objects with provenance, depth/risk, expected value, preservation and verification portfolios.

projection.name: Identity / provenance / living research objects
projection.description: BL-ADN, BL-LOG, BL-CHRONO, BL-PCRO, BL-OODP and BLOK preserve identity, version, dependency, critique and historical state without equating preservation with endorsement.

projection.name: Novelty / adversarial pressure
projection.description: BL-NOVO disciplines novelty claims; BL-REV and BL-AEGIS search for premise failures, countercases, contradictions and scope errors before expensive external verification.

projection.name: Reality-facing adjudication
projection.description: RVT/RVP/RVTP/RVL update model status from qualified evidence. Generative precedence may invert, but representation alone cannot self-declare actuality.

projection.name: Future regression / resource routing / agency
projection.description: BL-SFRET maps necessary future conditions and gaps; OPT-HKRP routes the minimal sufficient distributed coalition; OHAS defines authorized bounded execution, decision rights, safety and rollback.

projection.name: Knowledge-to-capability conversion
projection.description: KAT governs knowledge rights/disclosure and conversion of sufficiently supported useful knowledge into capability without permitting adverse-evidence suppression.

projection.name: Dual recursive frontier return
projection.description: New capability may reveal more Reality and trigger THUC_DINH, or create new possible world-states and trigger GIA_DINH. The return path is dual, not a single fixed Reality-Gap node.

projection.name: Publication / critique / revision spiral
projection.description: BL-PIRAL and social-response mechanisms publish, index, collect critique, audit, patch, version and republish; reaction is feedback, not a truth vote.

projection.name: Cross-cutting constitutions
projection.description: BL-ADN/LOG/CHRONO preserve identity and causal memory; BL-CPR limits public disclosure; Reality-facing correction constrains claim status while dynamic mode order remains non-hierarchical.

parallel_loops.hypothesis_determined_loop: GiaTai -> BL∞ -> Consequences/Test -> Reality -> revised GiaTai
parallel_loops.capability_loop: Knowledge -> Resources -> Agency -> Action -> Capability -> BL∞ -> Reality or GiaTai mode

progress_rule: A recursive pass counts as progress only when it produces an auditable evidence, model, GiaTai, scope, measurement, capability, negative-knowledge, provenance or risk delta.
guardrail: This artifact is a reduced public conceptual projection of the BL∞ dynamic Reality-GiaTai system. It exposes dual propositions, mode-dependent generative precedence, roles and recursive feedback only; it does not disclose protected production implementation.
